Find its angle of inclination, correct to $2$ decimal places.

questions.question_text: Find the angle of inclination of the vertical line $x=4$.

options.why: Confused a vertical line with a horizontal line, which has inclination $0^{\circ}$.
Measured a half turn along the $x$-axis instead of the quarter turn to the vertical.

questions.solution_text:
A vertical line rises straight up from the $x$-axis, a quarter turn from the positive $x$-axis.
$\theta=90^{\circ}$
